title: Reported end of Microsoft Research AI Frontiers and Langford&\#x27;s exit
summary: A Hacker News discussion centers on the reported disbanding of Microsoft Research&\#x27;s AI Frontiers group and the exit of researcher John Langford. Commenters framed the reported change as part of a broader industry narrowing toward transformer scaling and away from exploratory AI research. The submission links to an archived article and a secondary report, and the supplied material does not include Microsoft&\#x27;s own confirmation.
